note: The bands the Buzzard Bombshell plant has to land in, from docs/BOMBSHELL-STAGE1.md, which derives each from BMJR's published figures, Cox's figures for the Texaco .049 and the drawn model (scripts/bombshell-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Slow Stick's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

s1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent of the throttle stick, which is 85 percent of the engine's rpm, derived 8.08: the Bombshell's cruise

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 6.49; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.0 / 4.991, of the zero lift line

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 10.11

s5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds the plant flies unstalled, derived 0.91 at 7.5 m/s

s6_self_level.source: from a 30 deg bank at cruise, every stick centred: the four state lateral model gives 17.7, 11.6 and 7.8 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s, a spiral that halves the bank in 3.5 s; the bank at 6 s, the same side, and never steeper than it started

s7_rudder_bank.source: full right roll stick, which is full right rudder, from level cruise: 47.5 deg after 1 s by the lateral model, right wing down

s8_turn.source: a level 45 deg bank held on the rudder at full throttle: the radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown, the Cub's 15 percent, and the radius itself against the 9.08 m the level turn flies at 9.44 m/s with 5.6 deg of up elevator, within the same 15 percent. 90 percent will not hold a level 45 deg bank.

s9_stall_power_off.source: full up from cruise, throttle closed, held 8 s: the pitching moment, taken back through the stall (the post stall model of docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, re-derived for crash round 4: until then the flat plate past the stall, 15.6 deg, 8.7 m/s, 3.00 m/s), trims at 15.3 deg of alpha and the aircraft settles into a mush at 7.7 m/s sinking 1.98 m/s, within 25 percent; no wing drop, no yaw that is a spin, the nose never plunging

s9_stall_power_on.source: the same with the throttle left at cruise: no wing drop, no spin, no plunge

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model trimmed at the 8.08 m/s cruise, derived 5.63

s11_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.0197, the 7 x 3.5's shaft power at a power coefficient of 0.035 0.0294

s12_chop.source: throttle to idle from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

s13_throw.source: a throw at 8.5 m/s and cruise throttle with every stick centred, the elevator trimmed for 8 m/s: flying level after three seconds, not sinking out of the hand

s14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 8.50 deg and 0.1318 m, 14.0 percent on the skid

s15_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass with every stick centred, from standing: its three point attitude is past the stall, and the big stabiliser lifts the tail as the speed comes up; derived 17.2 m and 8.0 m/s, the roll tail up to the speed the neutral elevator trims at

s16_landing.source: a glide from 3 m at cruise, flared at half a metre: touches under 1.1 V_s (7.1 m/s) by the Slow Stick's margin, and comes to rest on its wheels and skid at S14's attitude, no hull

s17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, all from main's module at a0d9697, before the Bombshell existed. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub, glider, bramor, bramorChute, timber, timberf each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged The Radian's re-recorded again for crash round 5 on the lead's decision to take its 6 deg FITTED washout (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), not on an owner's flight: its recording first differs at 7.778 s, in the stall (npm run stall:crossing). Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6).

s18_cross_host.source: the Bombshell's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

s19_thermal.source: a straight pass at cruise through the core of the strongest thermal (2.5 m/s, 45 m, plant_wing.c), pitch stick centred: the aircraft rises with the air, w0 (16/15) R / V = 14.8 m, against the same flight in still air; the band is 25 percent

s20_idle.source: the throttle closed on the strip: the Cox throttle conversion idles the engine at 40 percent of its rpm, 3,740 of Cox's 9,350, and its 0.45 N of static thrust is under the 0.65 N of rolling and skid resistance, so the engine turns and the wheels' friction holds the aircraft: its ground speed is nil

s21_hands_off_glide.source: level at cruise, then the throttle closed and every stick let go, in Manual: the idle's thrust is nil over its 5.5 m/s pitch speed and the neutral elevator's pitching moment trims the glide at 7.55 deg of alpha, CL 0.658, 7.97 m/s sinking 0.919 m/s (bombshell:derive, hands off glide). The mean of 5 to 15 s, after the phugoid's first cycle; the sink band is S3's in proportion, the speed band S1's, and it never reaches the stall's alpha
